title: GLP-1 receptor agonists for weight loss in adults: a randomized trial
abstract: We randomly assigned 240 adults with obesity to once-weekly semaglutide or placebo for 52 weeks. Mean body weight change was -14.9 percent with semaglutide versus -2.4 percent with placebo.

title: Deep learning for diabetic retinopathy screening: a systematic review
abstract: We synthesized 38 studies evaluating deep learning algorithms for diabetic retinopathy screening. Pooled sensitivity was 0.92 and specificity 0.91 across settings. Heterogeneity was substantial between primary care and specialist settings.

title: Graph neural networks for molecular property prediction
abstract: We propose a graph neural network architecture that achieves state-of-the-art results on twelve molecular property benchmarks without quantum chemistry features.

title: Deep learning models for mortality prediction in ICU patients
abstract: We trained deep learning models on 40,000 ICU admissions to predict in-hospital mortality, achieving an AUROC of 0.87 on held-out data. External validation on a second hospital gave an AUROC of 0.84.
